expected_result: No predefined expected answer. Technical evidence is recorded for review.
actual_result: Directive 4.12: Dynamic memory allocation shall not be used. This rule applies to all dynamic memory allocation packages including: - Those provided by The Standard Library; - Third-party packages. The Standard Library's dynamic memory allocation and deallocation routines can lead to undefined behaviour as described in Rule 21.3. Any other dynamic memory allocation system is likely to exhibit undefined behaviours that are similar to those of The Standard Library. The specification of third-party routines shall be checked to ensure that dynamic memory allocation is not being used inadvertently.
